title: Session handoff: glyph-cli c9550288 onto its successor (2.1.326 renewal)
description:
Session handoff for the glyph-cli worker (session c9550288) onto its successor, the admitted 2.1.326 build (DEC-275 (a1), leader renewal at a clean boundary), 2026-11-17. STATE AT WRITE: origin/dev 76ab4db67a8283af7628878fd63f8a86b5eb416d before this PR (squash of #82); origin/main is untouched, no promotion was taken this session. Working tree clean, no open pull requests, nothing In Progress.

LANDED THIS SESSION, all through reviewed PRs into dev: GCLI-21 (#71), GCLI-11 (#73, under DEC-216 (a3), (a5)), GCLI-40 (#78, the code-map pure layer), GCLI-41 (#80, glyph code-map tiers 1, 2 and 4 with byte parity to opum-cli 91542f4). Tracker-only PRs: #70, #72, #74, #75, #76, #77, #79, #81, #82. GCLI-11, 21, 40 and 41 are Done.

NEXT, APPROVED BUT NOT YET BRIEFED: GCLI-37 (12b, tier 3: symbols named in the task text resolved through the index to their declaring files at score 0, plus depth-1 impact at score 1, a file in several tiers keeps its highest tier, tier 3 sits above git-grep, displacement at the cap recorded under omissions) then GCLI-38 (12c: time budget enforcement and measurement, then ADR 0005 and the README), approved for today by opum-doc as the remainder of GCLI-12. The brief comes from the leader with a floor check; do not start either before it arrives. Expected GCLI-37 paths for the floor: src/codemap.ts, src/codemap-tier3.ts (new), src/program.ts, src/snapshot.ts and src/cache.ts (read-only use of the ref-pinned index), src/queries.ts and src/impact.ts (read-only use), test/codemap.test.ts, test/codemap-tier3.test.ts (new), test/parity.test.ts, test/cli.test.ts, README.md, .quest/tasks/GCLI-37.json. Design is DEC-216 (a4) (carried verbatim in GCLI-37 and GCLI-38) with Q2 ruled (a6): reuse the producer's identifier extraction, match index symbols by EXACT name, include every symbol a name matches, each counted; qualified and fuzzy matching out of scope. Tier 3 must leave tiers 1, 2 and 4 byte-identical when glyph's index is absent or fails (the parity goldens stay valid). Read opum-cli only by ref (dev 91542f4 is the pin); never its working copy.

CARRIED NON-BLOCKING ITEMS, to fold into GCLI-37 where it touches the same files (also a note on GCLI-37 and on the completed GCLI-41): (1) the hostile-config test in test/parity.test.ts has no positive control; add an assertion that git config core.quotepath reads false under the hostile GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL. (2) The over-cap test title in test/cli.test.ts still says characters; say UTF-16 code units. (3) The README sentence that the code-map seam never reads the working tree's history by default is imprecise; tier 2 reads HEAD implicitly, and what it never reads is uncommitted changes. The UTF-16 item is CLOSED: DEC-216 (a8) is recorded verbatim on GCLI-41 (#82) and was never on GCLI-37's list, so there was nothing to drop there.

OTHER TASKS, all To Do and not started: GCLI-38 (12c, depends on GCLI-37; its description carries the quadratic extractor cost as a time-budget input), GCLI-39 (the DEC-216 (a6) rulings: barrel namespace importers, import {} as a module edge, export = namespace as unresolved), GCLI-35 (GCLI-11 review nits plus the (i)-(iii) notes), GCLI-34 (ADR 0002 exit-family wording, an amendment note), GCLI-26 to GCLI-31 (the earlier follow-ups, not admitted). GCLI-33 (DEC-278, the ref cache hashing arm) is unstarted. GCLI-18 is HELD (label hold) until the leader sends a brief; do not start it.

THREE PRODUCER DEFECTS in opum-cli's deterministic producer, ported as is for parity and pinned: quadratic extractors on a long unbroken token (about 0.2 s per call at 20,000 characters), a leading-dot path read (.quest/x as quest/x), and non-ASCII git grep paths coming back quoted because the grep reads lack core.quotepath=false. Glyph pins its grep reads to core.quotepath=true and --no-color. Recorded on GCLI-41; filing them upstream is opum-cli's through the leader.

REVIEW WORKTREES under .claude/worktrees/ stay in place (DEC-208): do not remove, deregister or prune any. The ones from this session are review-71-c11a7f0, review-73-3351255, review-73-db3611c, review-78-40cc391, review-78-c49e934, review-80-968a740 and review-80-7d609e6, beside the earlier ones.

MECHANICS THAT COST TIME: quest and lore are 0.14.1 under ~/.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.2/bin; prepend it per call (DEC-266) and do not touch the nvm default. bun is at ~/.bun/bin. The opum-workflow hooks refuse git commit while on dev and refuse git push composed with any other command, so branch first and run git push alone; and the ownership guard refuses shell-built paths such as $VAR/file, so use literal absolute paths. Record every reviewer verdict on the task with the model and head, and land each reviewed PR with gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <the cleared head> as one bare call, then confirm the dev push run green by the full SHA before reporting the merge. lore sync adds dated docs/log.md entries from git history; revert docs/log.md. The loop on every code task: floor, branch off dev, build, mutate each new rule once so exactly its own test reddens, green head, a detached review worktree .claude/worktrees/review-<pr>-<short sha>, the head SHA and path to the leader, no merge until a verdict.
